description: Read the messages in the conversation with one phone number, newest first. Each message has direction (inbound or outbound), body, status, created_at, and media_url for picture messages. For a group conversation, pass the thread_ref from list_conversations.

page.description: Page number, 1 for the newest messages. Default 1.

phone.description: The other party's phone number. Use E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567). A number without a country code is read in the country of the phone's SIM.

thread_ref.description: Optional. The conversation's thread_ref from list_conversations or a message. Required to read a group conversation; preferred over phone when known.

name: get_conversation
title: Read a conversation
